name: markup between two backticks a carriage return apart
why: A CommonMark line ending is a carriage return as much as a newline, so two lone '\r' characters end the paragraph exactly as a blank line does: neither backtick is paired and the tag between them is a real element. A reader that spells the rule '\n' alone pairs them and calls the text safe.

rows.headline: protection worked by surprise
